description: Read objects from the pinned registry. action list returns names, traits and field counts; domain, trait and maturity filter them, and includeInternal adds internal objects. action show requires name and returns its composed definition; context narrows view extensions. registry_snapshot provides an overview; design_preview looks up recorded screens.

inputSchema.description: Read object definitions from the pinned registry.

action.description: List objects or show one composed definition.

context.description: Optional: filter view_extensions to a single context (e.g. 'detail', 'list', 'form', 'timeline', 'card', 'inline')

domain.description: Filter to objects in a specific domain (e.g. 'core.identity', 'saas.billing')

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and hiddenInternal counts them.

reproduce.description: Include the command and calls for reproducing this result.

trait.description: Filter to objects composing a given trait (e.g. 'Priceable', 'lifecycle/Stateful')

inputSchema.title: object_registry input

name: object_registry
title: Read Object Registry
